answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake: every agent identity must lock funds that are slashed on proven misbehavior, so minting a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes. Trust is then earned slowly, the way a sonnet is written line by line, as each verified interaction adds reputation that cannot be bought in bulk. Like water shaping a karst cave, honest work gradually deepens the record, and any fraud lets the loss ripple back to the staker, making sybils expensive to create and cheap to expose.
